changeSet.author: nexus-f3yqd.2.22
changeSet.comment: MVV test column: the move's counter, nullable with no default, so a metadata-only change
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.chunks ADD COLUMN mvv_n integer;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.chunks DROP COLUMN mvv_n

changeSet.author: nexus-f3yqd.2.22
changeSet.comment: Register the MVV test move over nexus.chunks: one INSERT, nothing else
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO nexus.data_moves (label, template, driving_schema, driving_table, chunk_size, sleep_ms, statement_timeout_ms, verification, on_complete, changeset_id) VALUES ('mvv-chunks-stamp', 'UPDATE <driving_table> SET mvv_n = coalesce(t.mvv_n, 0) + 1 WHERE <chunking_clause>', 'nexus', 'chunks', 1000, 0, 600000, 'SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks t WHERE t.mvv_n IS NULL AND (t.tenant_id = $1 OR $1 IS NULL)', NULL, 'mvv-chunks-move-1');
